name: Eve Outdoor Cam (EU)

matter.note: No Eve page we found says the Outdoor Cam supports Matter; it is described as built for HomeKit Secure Video.

apple_home.note: Built exclusively for HomeKit Secure Video: clips are analysed on an Apple TV or HomePod and stored encrypted in iCloud; live view goes through the home hub.

google_home.note: Eve describes it as designed exclusively for HomeKit Secure Video and does not list Google Home; no page says explicitly that it is unsupported.

alexa.note: Eve describes it as designed exclusively for HomeKit Secure Video and does not list Alexa; no page says explicitly that it is unsupported.

smartthings.note: No maker or Samsung page found.

home_assistant.note: Only a community guide pairs it via the HomeKit integration plus go2rtc; no official Home Assistant docs for this camera.

hubRequired.note: No Eve bridge. An Apple home hub (Apple TV or HomePod) is needed for HomeKit Secure Video and remote access.

localControl.note: Eve says access, local or remote, goes through the home hub and never reaches the cloud unencrypted; fully local-only operation is not stated.

cameraType.note: Floodlight camera with a dimmable light, designed to replace an existing outdoor light.

power.note: Needs neutral and ground wires; the install replaces an existing floodlight.

localStorage.note: Recordings go to iCloud via HomeKit Secure Video; no maker page we saw mentions local storage.

subscription.note: An iCloud+ plan is needed for recording; Apple's plan size sets how many cameras are allowed.

summary: The Eve Outdoor Cam is a hardwired floodlight camera with 1080p video at 24 fps, a 157 degree view, two-way audio and an IP55 rating. It is built only for Apple HomeKit Secure Video, so recording needs iCloud+ and an Apple TV or HomePod as home hub. Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings are not listed by Eve.
caveats: Needs an iCloud+ plan and an Apple home hub; no recording without them.
Installation needs neutral and ground wires.
Specs and ecosystem facts come from 2022 launch-era pages; the EU variant's exact model number was not found.

sources.title: CES 2022: Eve Introduces Eve Outdoor Cam, the Only Floodlight Camera Designed Exclusively for HomeKit Secure Video
